title: Claude vs ChatGPT: which one for what
caption: Stop asking which is better. Ask which for what. The honest split, by task. Save this.

slides.headline: Claude vs ChatGPT:
slides.sub: Not which is better. Which, when.

left.label: CLAUDE — use this
items: Writing with a point of view

slides.title: Reasoning under nuance
slides.body: Claude. When the task has judgment calls, contradictions, or 'it depends' baked in, Claude holds the nuance longer without flattening it.

slides.title: Anything visual
slides.body: ChatGPT. Image generation, charts from data, screenshots-to-code. Claude reads images well but ChatGPT makes them.

slides.title: Shipping software
slides.body: Claude Code. Reads the repo, edits files, runs tests, doesn't hallucinate the codebase. The gap here is real.

slides.title: Fast factual lookup
slides.body: ChatGPT or Perplexity. When you just need the current answer with a source, not a thinking partner.

slides.title: One-line
bullets: If you only pay for one and you build → Claude. If you create content → ChatGPT.
